verdict.rationale:
Snowflake has a dedicated first-party feature, 'dbt Projects on Snowflake,' bringing the dbt lifecycle (develop/deploy/orchestrate/observe) natively into the platform, plus explicit migration docs from dbt Core, showing dbt is a documented, native citizen rather than a bolt-on. Community evidence (comm-9) independently confirms dbt models are used against Snowflake in production, corroborating real-world adoption of the integration.
missing for 10: standalone dbt-snowflake adapter documentation/versioning detail and independent commentary specifically validating the native dbt-Projects feature (vs. just dbt Core usage).
